tokens.name: glass-regular
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass, regular: the fill of `.lg` and `GlassSurface`. Floating controls and navigation over content, never the content layer itself. Opaque enough that `fg1` holds 4.5:1 on it over any colour of the theme's own palette, in rest, hover, press and tint. A web approximation of SwiftUI `.glassEffect()`; Apple publishes no numbers, so these values are this system's own.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass, clear: `.lg-clear`. Only over media or a 3D scene, and only for large type or icons: the ground shows through, so small text on it is not guaranteed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: The specular edge on the top and left of a glass surface. Glass has no border: this rim is its edge. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: glass-shade
tokens.usage: The inner shade on the bottom and right of a glass surface, and the divider between items in a glass group.
